# A test reaches into what a placed program builds at run time. A node a
# render slot makes -- under an `if` the test's path went through, or one
# the test fires -- is held in a package var of its option, set as it is
# made and null at each render's start (holdRead); a trigger fires the node
# that var holds. A node the package body makes under a branch is held the
# same way. A node a record holds is held as the record's constructor makes
# it, and let go as the record is destroyed, unless another record's took
# its place, so it is null once its branch is gone. An instance of a
# component built at run time is held as it is set, from the instances kept
# or a new one, and let go as it is destroyed (deepfire's `c.p`), and a test
# reads its state and fires its events through the record.

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c forward.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go forward.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c deepfire.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go deepfire.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c reserved.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go reserved.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c context.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go context.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c panel.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go panel.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c branch.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go branch.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c slot.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go slot.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# A component with state of its own is a record on win32, which keeps it
# per instance (#[gen.can(instanceState)]). A test reaches one copy of
# those a loop renders through the package's map from each copy's key,
# which each copy's root is read with: its state, a node it makes, the
# event it raises, and null once the loop no longer makes it.

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c copies.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go copies.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

-- forward.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component pick(@chose(a int, b string)) node {
    button #go(text="go", @click {
        chose(1, "x")
    })
}

component wrap(@picked(a int, b string)) node {
    var on = true
    if on {
        pick #p(@chose {
            picked()
        })
    }
}

component main node {
    var log = ""
    vbox {
        wrap #w(@picked(n, s) {
            log = log + "{n}{s};"
        })
    }
}

func testForward(t Test, c main) {
    if c.w.p != null {
        c.w.p.go.click()
        t.assert(c.log == "1x;")
    }
}

window {
    main
}
-- deepfire.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component tile(label string, @tapped(n int)) node {
    var taps = 0
    button #tap(text="tap", @click {
        taps = taps + 1
        tapped(taps)
    })
}

component panel(tag string) node {
    var log = ""
    vbox {
        tile #t(label="x", @tapped(k) {
            log = log + "{tag}{k};"
        })
        for var n = ["a", "b"] {
            tile #u(label=n, @tapped(k) {
                log = log + "{n}{k};"
            })
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var show = true
    vbox {
        if show {
            panel #p(tag="P")
        }
        panel #q(tag="Q")
    }
}

func testFire(t Test, c main) {
    if c.p != null {
        c.p.t.tapped(5)
        t.assert(c.p.log == "P5;")
        c.p.u[1].tapped(6)
        t.assert(c.p.log == "P5;b6;")
        c.p.t.tap.click()
        t.assert(c.p.log == "P5;b6;P1;")
    } else {
        t.assert(false)
    }
    c.q.u[0].tapped(2)
    t.assert(c.q.log == "a2;")
    t.assert(c.q.t.taps == 0)
}

window {
    main
}
-- reserved.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component badge(label string) node {
    var hits = 0
    button #m(text="hit", @click {
        hits = hits + 1
    })
}

component main node {
    var show = true
    vbox {
        if show {
            badge #b(label="one")
        }
    }
}

func testReserved(t Test, c main) {
    if c.b != null {
        c.b.m.click()
        t.assert(c.b.hits == 1)
    }
}

window {
    main
}
-- context.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

context #mode(true)

component blank node {
    text(value="y")
}

component holder node {
    vbox {
        if mode {
            blank #w
        }
        text(value="h")
    }
}

component main node {
    vbox {
        mode(false) {
            holder #p
        }
    }
}

func testContext(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.p.w == null)
}

window {
    main
}
-- panel.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component panel ui.node {
    var selected = 0
    ui.tabs(:selected=selected) {
        ui.tab(label="One") {
            var taps = 0
            ui.button #tap(text="{taps}", @click { taps += 1 })
        }
    }
}

func testPanel(t Test, c panel) {
    if c.tap != null {
        c.tap.click()
    }
    t.assert(c.tap != null && c.tap.text == "1")
}
-- branch.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component branch ui.node {
    var on = true
    ui.button #flip(text="flip", @click { on = !on })
    if on {
        ui.vbox {
            var taps = 0
            ui.button #tap(text="{taps}", @click { taps += 1 })
        }
    }
}

func testBranch(t Test, c branch) {
    if c.tap != null {
        c.tap.click()
    }
    t.assert(c.tap != null && c.tap.text == "1")
    c.flip.click()
    c.flip.click()
    t.assert(c.tap != null && c.tap.text == "0")
}

func testGoneWithItsBranch(t Test, c branch) {
    t.assert(c.tap != null)
    c.flip.click()
    t.assert(c.tap == null)
    c.flip.click()
    t.assert(c.tap != null && c.tap.text == "0")
}
-- slot.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output {
    go {
        bubbletea
        fyne
        gtk4
    }
    kotlin {
        android
    }
    none {
        html
    }
}

component card(content ...component node) node {
    var open = 0
    vbox {
        button(text="t {open}", @click { open = open + 1 })
        content
    }
}

component main node {
    var rows = [["a", "b"], ["c"]]
    var log = ""
    var shown = true
    vbox {
        button #swap(text="swap", @click { rows = [["d"], ["e", "f", "g"]] })
        for var row = rows {
            card {
                for var i, it = row {
                    button #cell(text=it, @click { log = "{i}{it}" })
                    button #mark(text=it, @click {
                        var s = "!"
                        log = "{it}{s}{row.map(func(x string) => x + "").length()}"
                    })
                }
            }
        }
        if shown {
            button #tag(text="x{log}", @click {
                var s = "q"
                log = log + s
            })
        }
        text(value=log)
    }
}

func testHandlerReadsItsContentsLoop(t Test, c main) {
    c.cell[1][0].click()
    t.assert(c.log == "0c")
    c.cell[0][1].click()
    t.assert(c.log == "1b")
    c.swap.click()
    c.cell[1][2].click()
    t.assert(c.log == "2g")
    c.mark[1][1].click()
    t.assert(c.log == "f!3")
    if c.tag != null {
        c.tag.click()
    }
    t.assert(c.log == "f!3q")
}

window {
    main
}
-- copies.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component tile(label string, @tapped(n int)) node {
    var taps = 0
    text #face(value="<{label}:{taps}>")
    button #tap(text="tap", @click {
        taps = taps + 1
        tapped(taps)
    })
}

component main node {
    var names list[string] = ["a", "b", "c"]
    var log = ""
    vbox {
        for var i, n = names {
            tile #r(label="{i}{n}", @tapped(k) {
                log = log + "{n}{k};"
            })
        }
        button #rev(text="rev", @click {
            names = ["c", "b", "a"]
        })
        button #drop(text="drop", @click {
            names = ["b", "c"]
        })
    }
}

func testReorder(t Test, c main) {
    c.r[0].tap.click()
    t.assert(c.r[0].taps == 1)
    t.assert(c.log == "a1;")
    c.rev.click()
    t.assert(c.r[0].label == "0c")
    t.assert(c.r[0].face.value == "<0c:{c.r[0].taps}>")
    c.r[0].tap.click()
    t.assert(c.log == "a1;c{c.r[0].taps};")
    c.r[2].tapped(9)
    t.assert(c.log == "a1;c{c.r[0].taps};a9;")
}

func testDrop(t Test, c main) {
    c.r[2].tap.click()
    t.assert(c.r[2].taps == 1)
    c.drop.click()
    t.assert(c.r[2] == null)
    t.assert(c.r[1].label == "1c")
    c.r[1].tap.click()
    t.assert(c.log == "c1;c{c.r[1].taps};")
}

window {
    main
}
